contracts.action: Picking the folder a workspace already points at via 'Change folder…' no longer shows the 'now points to the new folder' toast
contracts.equivalent_path: A real relocate: relocateActive transaction or registry.relocate, then the main-side probe/broadcast and the folderChanged toast.
contracts.before_after: Before: the early return gave a plain ok result and the renderer always showed the toast. After: the result carries unchanged:true (relocate.ts:44, index.ts:349), the type allows it (shared/types/workspaces.ts:168), and onRelocated returns early (workspaces-context.tsx:168). checkRelocate runs first (relocate.ts:37), and the caller's probe in relocateFolder still runs.
contracts.visible_effect: No toast and no window prompt when the same folder is picked. A different folder behaves as before.
contracts.failure_mode: Nothing new is async here. The flag is optional, so a result without it still shows the toast.

contracts.action: An offline edit of a pendingInit workspace keeps pendingInit, so a later relocate accepts a moved folder that has items and no identity
contracts.equivalent_path: availability(): with no identity.json it writes one under the registered id and clears pendingInit, pendingIdentity and pendingColorUpgrade (registry.ts:731-749). checkRelocate accepts such a folder only for pendingInit entries (registry.ts:855).
contracts.before_after: Before: edit deleted pendingInit even when savedToFolder was false, so checkRelocate refused the moved folder with has-items-no-identity. After: pendingInit is cleared only when the identity was written. pendingIdentity is still set when it was not (registry.ts:637-638), and the later probe writes the registry's name and color.
contracts.visible_effect: Change folder works for an edited, never-initialised workspace whose drive remounted elsewhere. The edited name and color reach the new folder through the probe.
contracts.failure_mode: If the probe write fails, the entry stays pending and the next probe retries, with no data lost. The edit's no-op branch (registry.ts:591) already treats pendingInit as not saved to the folder, so the two agree.

thread_replies.reply: Addressed. relocate.ts:44 returns `unchanged: true`, index.ts:349 passes it through, and `onRelocated` skips the toast when it is set (workspaces-context.tsx:168). relocate.test.ts:158 asserts the flag.
